SysDataModelXML.SQLScript: DECLARE @DOCNUM VARCHAR(30) = N'{0}' SELECT DOCKEY ,[SRCTYP] ,[SRCKEY] ITMNO ,[SRCKEY] ,[DOCTYP] ,[DOCNAM] ,[DOCDES] ,DOCDIR ,DOCURL name ,[DOCURL] picture --,'#LINKSERVER#/Files/Upload/'+[DOCDIR] name --,'#LINKSERVER#/Files/Upload/'+[DOCDIR] picture -- ,[DOCURL] ,[COMMENT] ,[B01] ,[B02] ,[CREUSR] ,[UPDUSR] ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16),[CREDAT],21) [CREDAT] ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16),[UPDDAT],21) [UPDDAT] FROM LINKDOC WHERE SRCKEY= @DOCNUM AND ISNULL(SRCKEY,'')<>'' ORDER BY [DOCNAM]
